note: Decision tree approved by Juan as a base (docs/tree-proposal.md, issue #25): 3 levels x 3 options, each grounded in the UBS scenario catalog (`catalog` = vendor/ubs-kit/Data/scenario-catalog.csv ids). Level 1 reproduces the UBS starter kit. Interventions of a node apply on top of its parent's. Every number is an editable assumption or a literal shown in `changes`; assumptions with verified=false are modelling choices. Results come from the engine (deterministic first), never from this file.

assumptions.label: Net salary if she starts working now
assumptions.source: UBS LauzHack starter kit scenario_config.json ('Start working'), illustrative. Checked against the starter kit file; the figure itself is illustrative, not market data

assumptions.label: Rent of a studio in Lausanne
assumptions.source: Statistique Vaud, Numerus 8-2026 'Loyers vaudois' (FSO structural survey, 2024 data), table T1: average net rent in Vaud CHF 896 (1 room) and CHF 1,198 (2 rooms); Lausanne CHF 20.3/m2 vs Vaud 19.1/m2 (https://www.vd.ch/fileadmin/user_upload/organisation/dfin/statvd/Publications/Numerus/Numerus-08-2026_Loyers.pdf). CHF 1,100 sits between a 1-room and a 2-room flat in Lausanne; new leases cost more. Net rent, utilities in other costs

assumptions.label: Master's tuition and study costs per year
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit (CHF 2,500 at months 0 and 12, tuition plus study costs). Low end: EPFL invoice CHF 780/semester = CHF 1,560/year (tuition CHF 730 + fees) for students with a Swiss entry qualification; foreign students subject to the tripled fee pay CHF 2,240/semester (https://www.epfl.ch/education/studies/tuition-fee-other-fees/). High end: UBS synthetic scenario-assumptions.csv annual_tuition_chf=8000 for P00001

assumptions.label: Student job income during the master's
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Master's degree' phase 1) and synthetic-profiles.csv reference income. Checked against the starter kit file; the figure itself is illustrative, not market data

assumptions.label: Net salary after the master's
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Master's degree' phase 2), illustrative. Checked against the starter kit file; the figure itself is illustrative, not market data

assumptions.label: Net salary abroad (EUR)
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Move abroad'), illustrative; exchange rate held constant. Checked against the starter kit file; the figure itself is illustrative, not market data Converted from the kit's CHF figure at EURCHF 0.9223 (ECB reference rate, 20 Nov 2026; #48 item 5), so the result at a constant rate is unchanged.

assumptions.label: One-off cost of moving abroad
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Move abroad' one-off cost). Checked against the starter kit file; the figure itself is illustrative, not market data

assumptions.label: Rent of a flat abroad, alone (EUR)
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: market rent of a small flat for a newcomer abroad (e.g. Berlin), from the UBS starter kit 'Move abroad' expenses split by the team and converted from the kit's CHF figure at EURCHF 0.9223 (ECB reference rate, 20 Nov 2026; #48 item 5), so the result at a constant rate is unchanged. The official Berlin Mietspiegel 2026 median EUR 7.71/m2 net cold (about EUR 310 for 40 m2, https://www.berlin.de/sen/sbw/presse/pressemeldungen/pressemitteilung.1674998.php) covers existing leases only and is far below new-lease prices; no official new-lease figure found (checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Negotiated raise on the first salary (about 5%)
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: a one-off negotiated raise of about 5% of CHF 4,200. Context: FSO Swiss Earnings Structure Survey 2024 median gross wage rises about 25% from ages 20-29 to 30-39 (FSO, https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/36195848/master), part of which is general wage growth already in the model; no official figure for a single negotiated raise (checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Raise after a promotion in year 3 (about 15%)
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: about 15% of CHF 4,200. FSO reports that 27-31% of master's graduates who changed jobs were promoted, but publishes no size of a promotion raise (https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/14941889/master, checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Assumed annual return of an 80% equity portfolio
assumptions.source: Derived from Pictet 'Performance of Swiss shares and bonds 1926-2024' (2025 edition, Table 1): geometric mean 7.7%/year nominal for Swiss shares and 4.0% for bonds, so an 80/20 mix earns about 6.9% before costs (https://www.pictet.com/content/dam/www/documents/publications/shares-and-bonds-in-switzerland/2025/PWM_Performance-Swiss-shares-and-bonds-EN.pdf). 5.5% = that minus about 1.4 points of fees and a margin of prudence (the deduction is a modelling choice)

assumptions.label: Volatility of an 80% equity portfolio
assumptions.source: Derived from Pictet 'Performance of Swiss shares and bonds 1926-2024' (2025 edition, Table 1): standard deviation 19.9% (shares) and 3.9% (bonds), correlation 28%, so an 80/20 mix has about 16.2%/year (https://www.pictet.com/content/dam/www/documents/publications/shares-and-bonds-in-switzerland/2025/PWM_Performance-Swiss-shares-and-bonds-EN.pdf)

assumptions.label: Resale value of the car after 2 years
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, corrected, not fully verified: the TCS cost-per-km method depreciates 7% of the catalogue price per year plus 2% per 10,000 km, about 20% after 2 years at 15,000 km/year (CHF 12,000 of 15,000; https://www.tcs.ch/de/testberichte-ratgeber/ratgeber/kontrollen-unterhalt/kilometerkosten-musterauto-2026.php); market resale values are lower (about 35% loss). The TCS booklet itself was not opened; Eurotax data is paywalled (checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Side job income
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: about a 20% student job. FSO 'Conditions d'etudes et de vie dans les hautes ecoles suisses' 2024: 72% of students work next to their studies, 29% at up to 20% (https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/36147161/master); the average income from work alone is only in the annex tables (checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Income from a 60% job while studying
assumptions.source: 60% of the CHF 4,200 junior salary. Proportional pay checked: the FSO Swiss Earnings Structure Survey standardises wages to full-time equivalents and only jobs at 50% or less earn clearly less per FTE (-13%; Statistique Vaud Numerus 6-2026, https://www.vd.ch/fileadmin/user_upload/organisation/dfin/statvd/Publications/Numerus/Numerus-06-2026_Salaires.pdf). The CHF 4,200 base is the starter-kit figure

assumptions.label: Income from an 80% job while studying
assumptions.source: 80% of the CHF 4,200 junior salary; proportional pay checked as for AS-alexia-parttime-income (FSO wage survey via Statistique Vaud Numerus 6-2026, https://www.vd.ch/fileadmin/user_upload/organisation/dfin/statvd/Publications/Numerus/Numerus-06-2026_Salaires.pdf). Feasibility of 80% next to studies remains a modelling choice

assumptions.label: Interest rate of the study loan
assumptions.source: Canton of Vaud study loans: interest-free during the studies and for 5 years after them; after that, 5%/year late interest (vd.ch repayment FAQ, https://www.vd.ch/formation/aides-financieres-aux-etudes-et-a-la-formation-professionnelle-bourses-ou-prets/informations-principales/questions-frequentes/remboursement). Node 2.2.3 ('rate rises to 5%') is that late-interest case

assumptions.label: Scholarship during the master's
assumptions.source: FSO 'Conditions d'etudes et de vie dans les hautes ecoles suisses' 2024: median study aid (grant or loan) per recipient CHF 597/month, CHF 744 for students living away from their parents (https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/36147161/master). Upper end: EPFL social scholarship at most CHF 2,100/month (Directive LEX 2.10.3, https://www.epfl.ch/about/overview/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/LEX-2.10.3_Directive-VPA-bourses-detudes_ENG_final.pdf)

assumptions.label: Paid internship in the second year
assumptions.source: EPFL 'Looking for an internship': EPFL recommends a minimum of CHF 2,000 per month for internships in Switzerland (no legal minimum) (https://epfl.ch/education/studies/en/rules-and-procedures/internships/looking-for-an-internship/)

assumptions.label: Raise after a promotion abroad in year 3 (about 15%, EUR)
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: about 15% of the salary abroad, same reasoning as AS-alexia-promotion (no official figure for the size of a promotion raise, checked 2026-11-21). Converted from the kit's CHF figure at EURCHF 0.9223 (ECB reference rate, 20 Nov 2026; #48 item 5), so the result at a constant rate is unchanged.

assumptions.label: Income from a side project
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: illustrative; a side project may earn nothing (no statistic applies, checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Net salary after a later master's, with experience
assumptions.source: Modelling choice, not verified: the starter-kit master's salary (CHF 4,800) plus about 8% for 3 years of prior work experience. Context: FSO graduate surveys give a median CHF 80,900 gross/year one year after a university master's (2023, https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/32172110/master) and CHF 95,000 five years after (2014 cohort, https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/14941889/master), both above the starter-kit scale used in this tree (checked 2026-11-21)

assumptions.label: Net salary of a job in Zurich, with experience
assumptions.source: Starter-kit master's salary CHF 4,800 (Lausanne) x 1.072, the Zurich premium over the Lake Geneva region in the FSO Swiss Earnings Structure Survey 2024 (median gross wage CHF 7,502 vs 6,998/month; https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets/36195855/master). No Zurich figure for young graduates is published; the ratio, not the base, is the verified part

assumptions.label: Rent of a studio in Zurich
assumptions.source: Statistik Stadt Zuerich, 'Mietpreise 2026 in der Stadt Zuerich' (1 April 2026): median net rent of a 2-room flat CHF 1,497/month; 1-room flats are not surveyed; rent with utilities is about 10-15% higher (https://www.stadt-zuerich.ch/artikel/de/statistik-und-daten/mietpreise-2026-in-der-stadt-zuerich.html)

root.label: Today: student in Lausanne
root.description: Alexia keeps her current life: student job of CHF 1,200 and CHF 1,500 of monthly costs.

children.description: Takes a full-time job now and moves to her own studio.

children.label: Keep the surplus in cash
children.description: Builds a safety buffer in a savings account; no investing.

children.label: Negotiate a 5% raise
children.description: Asks for a higher starting salary.

children.label: Promotion in year 3
children.description: About 15% more from month 25.

children.label: Work 80%
children.description: Keeps one day a week for herself: income x 0.8.

children.label: Invest CHF 500 a month
children.description: Puts CHF 500 a month into a balanced index fund.

children.label: Stay the course
children.description: Keeps investing whatever the markets do.

children.label: Pause in year 2
children.description: Stops the contributions for 12 months (months 13 to 24).

children.description: An 80% equity portfolio instead of a balanced one: higher assumed return, more volatility.

children.description: Borrows CHF 15,000 for a car at 6.9% over about 5 years; insurance and fuel add CHF 250 a month.

children.label: Sell the car after 2 years
children.description: Sells it in month 25 and goes back to public transport; the loan keeps its schedule.

children.label: Add a side job
children.description: Earns CHF 600 more a month for 2 years to afford the car.

children.label: Do a master's
children.description: Two years of master's with a student job, then a better-paid job.

children.label: Student job only
children.description: As in the UBS starter kit: CHF 1,200 a month from a student job.

children.label: Get a scholarship
children.description: About CHF 740 a month during the two years (median Swiss study aid, away from parents).

children.label: Graduate one year late
children.description: Three years of studies: one more year of student life and tuition.

children.label: Paid internship in year 2
children.description: CHF 2,000 a month (the EPFL recommended minimum) for the 12 months of year 2.

children.label: Study loan of CHF 15,000
children.description: Borrows CHF 15,000 interest-free (Vaud study loan), repaid at CHF 300 a month once she works (month 25).

children.label: Repay over about 5 years
children.description: CHF 300 a month from graduation.

children.label: Repay fast
children.description: CHF 600 a month from graduation.

children.label: Rate rises to 5%
children.description: Stress case: the loan charges 5% from graduation (Vaud charges 5% only on late repayment).

children.label: Part-time master's with a 60% job
children.description: Three years instead of two, with a 60% job; the better-paid job starts in month 37.

children.label: Employer pays the tuition
children.description: The employer reimburses the tuition each year.

children.label: Work 80% instead
children.description: More income, same three years of studies.

children.label: Drop out after year 1
children.description: Leaves the programme and takes the full-time job in month 13.

children.label: Move abroad
children.description: Takes a job in another country; the exchange rate is held constant.

children.label: Rent a flat alone
children.description: Her own flat abroad.

children.label: Invest CHF 400 a month
children.description: Puts CHF 400 a month into a balanced fund.

children.label: Promotion in year 3
children.description: About 15% more from month 25.

children.label: Expensive move
children.description: Deposit and agency fees add CHF 2,500 on day one.

children.label: Share a flat
children.description: A shared flat: CHF 500 a month less rent.

children.description: Keeps the saved rent in cash.

children.description: Six months unpaid in year 3 plus CHF 4,000 of travel.

children.label: Come back after 3 years
children.description: Returns to Lausanne in year 4 with a Swiss salary; moving back costs CHF 3,000.

children.description: Back in Lausanne with experience.

children.description: Master's from month 37 to 60 with a student job, then CHF 5,200 a month.
